name: Document Creator (DOCX)
description: Creates Microsoft Word documents using Python python-docx library
systemPromptFragment:
You can create .docx Word documents using Python. Use the run_command tool to execute a Python script that creates the document. The python-docx library is available. Example:

```python
from docx import Document
doc = Document()
doc.add_heading('Title', 0)
doc.add_paragraph('Content here')
doc.save('output.docx')
```

Always save the document to the workspace folder. Use proper formatting: headings for structure, paragraphs for content, tables where appropriate.
